import html from typing import List # Example template – adjust placeholders as needed for the actual application. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a user's forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The name of the user who authored the post. title : str The post's title. body : str The main content of the post. post_tags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string that can safely be embedded in a web page. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS attacks safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # preserve line breaks and formatting # Build the tags string: each tag wrapped in a element safe_tags = ' '.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ) # Populate the template with sanitized values return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body.replace('\n', '
'), # preserve newlines tags=safe_tags )
